_comment: Atlas Vector Search index definition for the `title_vectors` collection.
HOW TO CREATE IT
Atlas UI:  Cluster -> Atlas Search -> Create Search Index ->
JSON Editor -> Vector Search -> paste the `definition` object
below -> name it `vector_index`.
Atlas CLI: atlas clusters search indexes create --file db/mongo/02_vector_index.json
WHY THESE SETTINGS
numDimensions 384 — matches all-MiniLM-L6-v2, the model named in
MySQL title_embeddings.model_name. The two MUST agree; if the model is
ever changed, this index has to be rebuilt and every vector recomputed.
similarity cosine — the embeddings are L2-normalised, so cosine measures
pure orientation (topic/mood) and ignores magnitude. For normalised
vectors cosine and dotProduct rank identically; cosine is kept because
it stays correct if normalisation is ever dropped.
filter fields — type/genres/releaseYear are declared as filters so a
session restricted to books narrows the candidate set BEFORE the ANN
search runs, rather than discarding results afterwards.
NO ATLAS CLUSTER? The application falls back to exact cosine similarity
computed in Node (VECTOR_BACKEND=local in .env). At this catalogue size
that is a few milliseconds and returns identical rankings, since brute
force is what ANN approximates. See src/lib/vector.js.
